Rejecting all omitted masks **breaks this API’s contract**. Books v2 explicitly makes `updateMask` optional and selects only mutable fields populated with nonempty values when it is omitted ([contract.json]( /tmp/tal-skills-fieldmask-native-2026-10-15-r01/trials/source07-microservice-v3-aip134-omitted-mask-03/workspace/project/contract.json:10)).

Each request independently starts from the original resource. These are **contract-derived expected results**, not observed execution results:

| Request | Selected mutable fields | Resulting resource |
|---|---|---|
| `omitted-mask` | `title` | `{"name":"publishers/P1/books/B2","title":"New","author":"Lin","rating":5}` |
| `explicit-author-reset` | `author` | `{"name":"publishers/P1/books/B2","title":"Old","author":"","rating":5}` |
| `wildcard-replacement` | `title`, `author`, `rating` | `{"name":"publishers/P1/books/B2","title":"New","author":"","rating":0}` |

For the omitted mask, the empty `author` does not select that field, and absent `rating` remains unchanged. For the explicit mask, selecting `author` intentionally writes its empty-string default. For `*`, replacement includes every mutable field, so absent `rating` takes its declared default, `0`. `name` identifies the resource throughout ([contract.json](/tmp/tal-skills-fieldmask-native-2026-10-15-r01/trials/source07-microservice-v3-aip134-omitted-mask-03/workspace/project/contract.json:7)).

The supplied v1 request is valid under that dialect and preserves the later `rating` field. Rejecting it before the update implementation changes accepted inputs and breaks the supported client’s documented behavior. Retain optional-mask handling, explicit masks for intentional clearing, and `*` for deliberate replacement. If mandatory masks are desired, introduce that requirement through an explicitly separate contract with migration and coexistence.
